sample_sim_1_desc: Sample simulation content from this category.
states_of_matter_desc: Explore solid, liquid, and gas states as 1200 particles respond to temperature changes
states_of_matter_content: Matter exists in three basic states. In solid state, particles are strongly bonded maintaining a fixed shape and volume. As temperature rises, particles vibrate more, transitioning to liquid state where it maintains volume but flows freely. Further heating transforms it into gas state with rapidly moving particles that lack fixed shape or volume.
states_of_water_desc: Observe water molecule transformation through ice, liquid, steam, and plasma stages
states_of_water_content: Water demonstrates remarkable phase transitions: ice below 0°C, liquid with gradual evaporation between 0-100°C, steam above 100°C, and plasma at extreme temperatures. Each H₂O molecule consists of one oxygen atom (red) and two hydrogen atoms (white).
candle_extinguishing_desc: Simulate oxygen depletion and combustion mechanics in enclosed environments
light_refraction_desc: Interactive ray tracing simulation exploring light reflection and refraction with adjustable angles and refractive indices
light_refraction_content: Observe how light bends and reflects as it passes through various materials. Adjust incident angle and refractive index to explore Snell's law in real-time. Observe total internal reflection when light undergoes critical angle.
optics_and_waves_subtitle: Explore the fascinating world of light and waves through interactive 3D simulations
